title: Cancer kept the ex’s stuff. In a museum.
caption: Cancer built a whole museum for the hoodie, the playlist and the memories. Keeping sweet memories is fine. Holding on to their stuff can keep a door half open. Keep the memory, and kindly give the hoodie back. Send this to the friend with a hoodie drawer.
